immutableCandidate: Qualification starts from a clean committed tree and a new external candidate directory outside the checkout.
One regular non-symlink tarball is retained with mode 0444; immutable JSON receipts use mode 0400.

Dry-pack and retained observations must match. Candidate identity binds exact bytes, SHA-256, SHA-512 integrity, byte length, construction and exact-artifact smoke evidence, source receipt, source and metadata commits, adapter, package, version, registry, public tag, and candidate tag.
Every later phase revalidates containment, bytes, integrity, permissions, receipts, and current metadata.
approval: Registry mutation requires immutable approval with scope registry-mutation and a bounded approving principal.

Approval binds the candidate digest, package, version, integrity, registry, and expected public tag. The candidate digest transitively binds the full artifact and provenance tuple; the CI attestation separately binds the source run ID.
Credentials, local config, branch push, source receipt, and CI success are not approval. CI also requires the exact transferred candidate and its attestation.
replay: Absent state uploads the exact retained artifact once to the candidate tag. Matching staged or promoted state replays without upload.
Conflicting integrity, escaped or changed bytes, malformed state, a stale tag, or an already-ahead public tag fails before mutation.
Retries use the same candidate. They never rebuild, rerun source qualification, roll back, or move a tag backward. Matching replay does not require credentials.
provenance: agentera.gitRef is an immutable 40-character source commit; candidate metadataCommit is qualification HEAD.
CI attestation binds candidate digest, source and metadata commits, repository, workflow reference, and numeric run ID.

Before protected approval, separate API-backed validation confirms the run event, conclusion, branch, head SHA, workflow identity, and candidate binding. The approved job checks out the same commit, downloads the artifact again, and rechecks the binding. OIDC provenance remains deferred.
convergence: The ordered envelope stages retained bytes on the candidate tag, waits for exact integrity and smoke, runs independent npm candidate migration smoke while the public tag is unchanged, promotes only forward, then waits for integrity and tag convergence plus final smoke.
Registry convergence uses six attempts with 5000 ms delay and rechecks compatibility each time.

The qualified publication envelope uses a monotonic clock, remains below 120000 ms, reconciles owner and unattributed time, retains the first failure, suppresses later phases, and records noRollback true.
The timing receipt binds candidate digest, metadata commit, package, version, artifact SHA-256 and integrity, and source run ID.
